verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm an official Gemini app for Mac that works without a browser, and a system-wide Option + Space shortcut that brings up the chat window. On-screen awareness is documented only for Android ('Hey Google' for help with what's on your screen), plus a passing mention of Gemini Live screenshares, so desktop screen access is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented screen-content access in the desktop app, Windows/other desktop OS support, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.
